erttu_1.m: Hello there outsider. In general, we dislike outsiders here in Vilegard, but there is something about you that I find familiar.

erttu_default.m: What do you want to talk about?
r: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
What can you tell me about Vilegard?

erttu_distrust_1.m: Most of us that live here in Vilegard have a history of trusting people too much. People that have hurt us in the end.

erttu_distrust_2.m: Now we start by being suspicious, and ask that outsiders coming here gain our trust by helping us first.

erttu_distrust_3.m: Also, other people generally look down upon us here in Vilegard for some reason. Especially those snobs from Feygard and the northern cities.
r: What else can you tell me about Vilegard?

erttu_vilegard_1.m: We have almost everything we need here in Vilegard. Our center of the village is the chapel.

erttu_vilegard_2.m: The chapel serves as our place of worship for the Shadow, and also as our place to gather when discussing larger issues in our village.

erttu_vilegard_3.m: Apart from the chapel, we have a tavern, a smith and an armorer.
r: Thanks for the information. There was something else I wanted to talk about.
Wow, nothing more? I wonder what I am doing in a puny village such as this one.

vilegard.10: The people of Vilegard are very suspicious of outsiders. I was told to go see Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel if I want to gain their trust.
vilegard.20: I have talked to Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel. He suggests I help three influential people in order to gain the trust of the people in Vilegard. I should help Kaori, Wrye and Jolnor in Vilegard.
vilegard.30: I have helped all three people in Vilegard that Jolnor suggested. Now the people of Vilegard should trust me more.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
